name: FLIRCameraDriverPlugin
description: FLIRCameraDriverPlugin consumes FLIR camera pedestrian detection data and publishes it as Sensor Detected Objects used for Cooperative Perception Messages like SDSM.

messageTypes.description: Sensor Detected Object Message used for Cooperative Perception Messages like SDSM. This message is used to send detected objects from the FLIR camera to the V2I Hub.

configuration.description: A list of dictionaries containing the configuration for each FLIR camera. Each dictionary should contain the following keys: WebSocketHost, WebSocketPort, Endpoint, CameraRotation, and SensorId.
Camera link monitoring: a camera frame held this many milliseconds longer in transit than the frame before it is logged as a link stall. Minimum 200. Read when the plugin starts.
Camera link monitoring: milliseconds between TCP connection checks of each camera and control host, and the time each check may take. 0 disables link checks. Minimum 50. Read when the plugin starts.

Camera link monitoring: comma-separated host[:port] list (default port 80) of other devices on the network, such as the gateway, checked like the cameras. A camera that stops answering while a control host answers points to the camera's link. Read when the plugin starts.
The log level for this plugin

Name of the log file for this plugin. If a relative path is provided, this file will create a directory under /var/log/<PluginName> and add the file here. Not including this parameter or setting to (-) will direct log output to stdout which is the default behavior. NOTE: File logging for plugins should only be used for temporary data collection. Current file logging does not have mechanisms to purge data after a certain time or size.
